answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique streaming account with watch history. It works because watch history no bot can fake, and the grove it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate watch history no bot can fake a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the shale of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Time is the tax here: watch history no bot can fake cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the zephyr for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
